fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches user accounts from API with caching mechanism
postconditions: Account list returned or empty list if none found
business_logic_steps: 1. Check if accountCachedData is not null
2. If cached data exists, return cached accounts
3. If no cache, call AccountApi.getAccounts() to fetch from API
4. Check if retrieved accounts list is null or empty
5. Return empty list if no accounts, otherwise return account list
6. Cache is populated during getAccountCachedData() call

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches balance information for a specific account
postconditions: AccountBalance object returned with all balance components
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher context
2. Call AccountApi.getAccountBalance with accountId parameter
3. API returns AccountBalance with overdraft, amount, cleared/effective balances
4. Return complete AccountBalance object to caller
5. No caching or transformation applied
6. Direct API passthrough with context switching

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches individual user identity information
postconditions: User object with personal details returned
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher context
2. Call UserApi.getUser() with default authorization headers
3. API returns User object with personal information
4. Return User entity containing name, email, phone, DOB
5. No transformation or caching applied
6. Direct API response forwarding

fr24_capabilities.description: Downloads account holder's profile image as base64 string
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher context
2. Call AccountApi.getAccountPicture with accountHolderId
3. API returns base64 encoded image string
4. Return string directly to caller
5. No image processing or validation
6. Raw base64 string passthrough

fr24_capabilities.description: Uploads new profile picture for account holder
postconditions: Image uploaded successfully or error returned
business_logic_steps: 1. Switch to IO dispatcher context
2. Convert File to RequestBody with image/* media type
3. Call AccountApi.uploadAccountPicture with accountHolderId and RequestBody
4. API processes image upload and returns response array
5. Return nullable Array<String> response to caller
6. No local image validation or preprocessing

fr24_capabilities.description: Retrieves the account holder through the repository layer (AccountRepository.retrieveAccountHolder). Returns AccountHolder.
business_logic_steps: 1. Caller invokes AccountRepository.retrieveAccountHolder().
2. Repository dispatches work on Dispatchers.IO.
3. Network / cache interaction runs to completion.
4. Result (AccountHolder) is returned to the caller.

fr25_business_rules.description: Before upload the bitmap is re-oriented from its EXIF metadata so the server-side copy matches the device's capture orientation.
Network / disk work is hopped off the main thread via Dispatchers.IO to keep the UI responsive.
Null / missing collections are defaulted to an empty list so downstream UI code never has to null-check.
Image uploads build a MediaType tagged with an image/* content type so the multipart body is typed correctly for the server.
Background-thread results are delivered to observers via postValue so the emit lands on the main thread.
Accounts are cached in memory to avoid repeated API calls

4. Register all feature modules (dashboard, viewModel, userRepository, baseNetwork, accountRepository, transactionsRepository)
5. Complete DI container setup for application lifecycle

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches transaction data for a specific date interval and displays it in a paginated dashboard view
business_logic_steps: 1. Receive DateInterval parameter from UI layer
2. Launch coroutine on IO dispatcher for network call
3. Retrieve first account from AccountRepository
4. Call TransactionsRepository with account and date range
5. On success, clear error state and update view with results
6. On exception, log error and post error message to LiveData

fr24_capabilities.description: Shows the user's current account balance with formatted amount and cents display
postconditions: Balance displayed in main and cents components
business_logic_steps: 1. Initialize ViewModel and automatically trigger balance fetch
2. Call AccountRepository to retrieve account balance
3. Convert raw balance data using DashboardLocalMapper
4. Format amount into main and cents components
5. Post formatted balance to accountBalanceLiveData
6. UI observes LiveData and updates balance display

fr24_capabilities.description: Allows users to take a photo and upload it as their profile picture with permission handling
business_logic_steps: 1. Request camera and storage permissions from user
2. Launch camera activity result launcher on permission grant
3. Receive bitmap from camera capture result
4. Convert bitmap to file path using ImageUtils helper
5. Call ViewModel uploadProfilePicture with bitmap and file
6. Update profilePictureLiveData and refresh UI display

fr24_capabilities.description: Provides month-by-month navigation of transaction history with ViewPager2 interface
postconditions: Transaction data loaded for selected month
business_logic_steps: 1. User swipes or clicks navigation buttons to change month
2. ViewPager2 triggers onPageSelected callback with new position
3. Update month title using DateFormatSymbols for position
4. Call ViewModel getPurchases with corresponding DateInterval
5. Set parent adapter loading state to true and notify
6. ViewModel posts results to purchasesLiveData for UI update

fr24_capabilities.description: Retrieves the user info and publishes the result to the UI via LiveData (DashboardViewModel.getUserInfo).
business_logic_steps: 1. UI invokes DashboardViewModel.getUserInfo().
2. viewModelScope.launch dispatches the repository call on Dispatchers.IO.
3. Result is collected and posted to the matching LiveData.
4. Observers receive the update on the main thread.

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches individual user identity information from the API

business_logic_steps: 1. Construct authorization header with Bearer token using API_KEY
2. Set Accept header to application/json
3. Make GET request to api/{version}/identity/individual endpoint
4. Return User entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches all user accounts from the API
postconditions: Accounts object returned with account list
business_logic_steps: 1. Construct authorization header with Bearer token using API_KEY
2. Set Accept header to application/json
3. Make GET request to api/{version}/accounts endpoint
4. Return Accounts entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches balance information for a specific account
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate accountId parameter is provided
2. Construct authorization header with Bearer token
3. Set Accept header to application/json
4. Make GET request to api/{version}/accounts/{accountId}/balance
5. Return AccountBalance entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches account holder information from the API
business_logic_steps: 1. Construct authorization header with Bearer token
2. Set Accept header to application/json
3. Make GET request to api/{version}/account-holder endpoint
4. Return AccountHolder entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Uploads a profile image for an account holder
postconditions: Array of strings returned or null on failure
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate accountHolder parameter and requestBody are provided
2. Set Content-type header to image/jpeg
3. Construct authorization header with Bearer token
4. Make PUT request to api/{version}/account-holder/{accountHolder}/profile-image
5. Return Array<String> response or null if upload fails

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches purchase transactions within a date range for specific account and category
postconditions: Purchases object returned with transaction data
business_logic_steps: 1. Validate account, category, minTime, and maxTime parameters
2. Construct authorization header with Bearer token
3. Set Accept header to application/json
4. Make GET request with path and query parameters
5. Return Purchases entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches all payees from the API

business_logic_steps: 1. Construct authorization header with Bearer token
2. Set Accept header to application/json
3. Make GET request to api/{version}/payees endpoint
4. Return Payees entity from API response

fr24_capabilities.description: Creates a new payee in the system

2. Construct authorization header with Bearer token

fr24_capabilities.description: Fetches the list of payees for the current account from the API

3. If network call fails, catch exception and return empty list
4. Map API payee entities to local payee models using PayeesLocalMapper

6. UI adapters receive updated data and refresh display

fr24_capabilities.description: Creates a new payee record via API call with form validation

2. Call repository createPayee method on IO dispatcher
3. If API call fails, catch exception and create default error response
